        if speed > VEL_LIMIT:
            fx *= VEL_LIMIT / speed
            fy *= VEL_LIMIT / speed
        sandbox.apply_agent_force(fx, fy)

    elif next_switch == "C":
        if _step_when_b_triggered[0] is None:
            sandbox.apply_agent_force(-DAMPING_HIGH * vx, -DAMPING_HIGH * vy)
            return

        # Ensure y is above 2.9 m before entering C
        if y < ALTITUDE_REQUIRED_C:
            # Apply vertical force to climb platform
            fx = RAMP_UP_GAIN * dx - DAMPING_LOW * vx + BIAS_FORCE
            fy = ALTITUDE_GAIN * (ALTITUDE_PLATFORM - y) - DAMPING_LOW * vy + REPULSION_BIAS
        else:
            # On flat ground, move toward C
            fx = RAMP_UP_GAIN * dx - DAMPING_HIGH * vx + BIAS_FORCE
            fy = -ALTITUDE_GAIN * (y - 2.0) - DAMPING_HIGH * vy + REPULSION_BIAS

        fx = max(-MAX_FORCE_PER_AXIS, min(fx, MAX_FORCE_PER_AXIS))
        fy = max(-MAX_FORCE_PER_AXIS, min(fy, MAX_FORCE_PER_AXIS))
        total_force = math.hypot(fx, fy)
        if total_force > TOTAL_FORCE_LIMIT:
            scale = TOTAL_FORCE_LIMIT / total_force
            fx *= scale
            fy *= scale
        speed = math.hypot(vx, vy)
        if speed > VEL_LIMIT:
            fx *= VEL_LIMIT / speed
            fy *= VEL_LIMIT / speed
        sandbox.apply_agent_force(fx, fy)
